nodes.label: H3v: Visual-only inertia / Matrix flicker theories
nodes.rationale: Resolved theory: flicker was caused by visual-inertia spring dropping to raw pose on frames where dtSec was zero due to timer resolution.

nodes.label: H6: KEX pitch drift is caused by pure delta integration
nodes.rationale: Confirmed theory: pitch drift was resolved by implementing a pitch servo to align authoritative gameplay pitch with object-triplet pitch.

nodes.label: H28: Weapon viewmodels can be world-occluded
nodes.rationale: Confirmed theory: preserving world depth across the viewmodel pass allows for natural occlusion by nearby geometry.
